dedupe_keys.name: supplementary data and code for performance based underground hydrogen storage screening under reservoir and infrastructure constraints

description: The authors provide anonymised reservoir inputs and outputs with a worked Python notebook for hydrogen-storage screening. The notebook covers fluid properties, deliverability, inventory, working gas, cushion gas and injectivity. The provider is Saeed Harati; Sara Louise Walker; Jamie Blanche; David Flynn. Coverage: The example is an anonymised reservoir. Geographic coverage is undisclosed; the description uses a 90-day deliverability condition, not an observational time series. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The public deposit metadata specify CC-BY-4.0. The notebook and tables were not downloaded. Limitations: The provider records corrections to inventory accounting between versions. Reservoir identities are anonymised and validation beyond the worked example is not established. For simulation it supports reproducing the study’s reservoir and infrastructure constraints on hydrogen-storage capacity. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
